LanguageData.CTA_Description: Potentially stalled tasks. Elapsed time alone is not proof of a defect.
LanguageData.CTA_Empty: {0} empty cells; may not be plantable
LanguageData.CTA_Notification: {0} tasks need review. See Colony Task Auditor mod settings.
LanguageData.CTA_Partial: Partial scan; task counts may be incomplete.
LanguageData.CTA_Unknown: Unknown; inspect worker, materials, skills and reservations
LanguageData.CTA_Paused: Intentionally paused or not currently due
LanguageData.CTA_Forbidden: Target is forbidden: treated as an intentional pause, not aged
LanguageData.CTA_NoWorker: No colonist has the relevant work type enabled
LanguageData.CTA_BillRestriction: Bill worker/skill restrictions exclude current colonists
LanguageData.CTA_Working: Worker activity observed; not a stall
LanguageData.CTA_Unreachable: No checked available worker can reach target
LanguageData.CTA_MaterialMissing: Undelivered construction material exceeds available spawned stocks; inventory/delivery contents unverified
LanguageData.CTA_MaterialDelivery: Construction materials are not yet delivered; stock access and hauling need inspection
LanguageData.CTA_Reserved: Target is reserved and available workers cannot reserve it; inspect reservation owner
LanguageData.CTA_Skill: No enabled worker meets recipe or construction skill requirements
LanguageData.CTA_BillMaterials: No permitted spawned item matches a recipe ingredient; inventories and delivery are unverified
LanguageData.CTA_ProgressHookUnavailable: Completion observer unavailable: bill completion between samples is unverified. Check Harmony.
LanguageData.CTA_Timing: First observed tick {0}; first sampled work {1}; last progress {2}
LanguageData.CTA_HeldBacklog: waiting in queue (same work is in progress elsewhere)
LanguageData.CTA_PartialFailed: Partial scan: {0} entries could not be inspected and were skipped (see log).
LanguageData.CTA_AlertExplanation: These tasks have not progressed for the configured number of days while work was possible. The cause shown is a diagnosis with the stated confidence, not a certainty.
LanguageData.CTA_AlertClick: Click to open the list. While the list is open, clicking jumps to each location in turn.
LanguageData.CTA_ShowAlert: Show an alert for stalled tasks
LanguageData.CTA_Queued: Waiting for the active bill on this autonomous workbench
LanguageData.CTA_MineQueued: Interior mining cell: reachable after surrounding rock is mined
LanguageData.CTA_SowBlocked: Every empty cell is occupied by items: haul them away to sow
LanguageData.CTA_NoWorkersOnMap: No colonists or mechanoids on this map: judgement paused
LanguageData.CTA_TargetGone: Task removed, moved, completed, disabled or not observed. No action is available.
LanguageData.CTA_ActionEvidence: Only a freshly verified supported job can be assisted. An inferred cause, deliberate pause, normal queue or partial scan never triggers automation.
LanguageData.CTA_MaterialAssumptions: Materials: spawned permitted/forbidden stacks are shown separately. Inventory, hauling, access and alternative ingredient combinations are not proven by these counts. Recipe ingredient rows are alternatives, not totals.
LanguageData.CTA_RecipeAdvice: Existing recipe/workbench candidates (advice only; ingredients and completion are unverified):
LanguageData.CTA_WorkerDiagnostics: Worker diagnostics: {0}; explicit sowing minimum {1}. Recipe/build skill checks still apply.
LanguageData.CTA_WorkerCandidate: Enabled candidate; actual job still needs verification
LanguageData.CTA_WorkerOff: Manually disabled work; never enabled automatically
LanguageData.CTA_WorkerUnavailable: Drafted, asleep, downed or mental state
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyInspect: Inspect the work target and settings. The cause is not established.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyMaterials: Check material alternatives and storage. A count shortage is advisory, not proof that crafting must be started.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyDelivery: Check hauling, forbidden stacks and obstructions. Do not recreate a production bill merely because materials are undelivered.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyAssignment: Review the named work type and enabled workers. Deliberately disabled work remains disabled.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedySkill: Choose a worker who meets recipe, construction and planting skills; train skills or adjust the task manually.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyRestriction: Review the bill’s worker and skill restrictions manually.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyReach: Inspect doors, areas and safe routes. No forbidden door/area is changed automatically.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyReserved: Wait for the reservation owner or inspect the active job. Reservations are never cleared automatically.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyManualPause: This is a deliberate pause/forbid. Resume manually if intended.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyWait: Wait for current work, sleep, queues or the growing season; no automatic intervention.
LanguageData.CTA_RemedyReady: A supported executable job was verified for this worker. A bounded priority request can be previewed.
